novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that "the retrieval key computed at the answer position blends the true subject with the distractor" and that targeted attention re-focusing reverses the resulting factual-recall failure, so its novelty route is a specific mechanism and measurement rather than merely a new distraction setting. Searches around "irrelevant context factual recall mechanistic interpretability," "distractor attention hijacking LLM," and "contextual interference retrieval heads" identify the closest work as Stochastic Chameleons (2025), which already attributes irrelevant-context errors to competing query-based and contextual-cue circuits, alongside Fierro et al. (2024), which describes attention heads routing topic information during factual recall. Moving from those results to distractor-mass diversion at answer-position retrieval heads and its targeted suppression is a non-trivial but natural extension and operationalization, not a new core explanatory framework or paradigm.
